customManagers.description: The Grafana plugins that Grafana preinstalls, pinned as <id>@<version> in the plugins value (#2022).
The uv version of the runner tools table. A test compares it with the Dockerfile.
The Node major of the runner tools table. A test compares it with the Dockerfile and .node-version.
The Python minor of the setup-uv python-version inputs.
The Python minor of the apt package and the tool environments of the devcontainer image.
The Python minor of the type checkers, the tools lock and DEFAULT_PYTHON_VERSION.
The Python minor of the uv compile command in the header of each hashed requirements file of the tools lock, and in the bump steps of tools.lock.
The PostgreSQL image of a CloudNativePG Cluster (spec.imageName), which the kubernetes manager does not read. The Image Updater values hold a deeper imageName field.
The Mattermost version of the Mattermost resource, which names its image and tag in two fields.
The Gitea image tag. The chart gives the registry and the repository, so the helm-values manager cannot read it.
The DCGM exporter image tag, <DCGM version>-<exporter version>-<variant>. The exporter version is the version of the chart.
The one tag of the Argo Workflows controller and executor. It equals the argo pin of the tools lock.
The version of each Python tool of the tools lock. The pip-compile manager updates its <name>.in and <name>.txt.
The OpenSpec version of the tools lock. The npm manager updates openspec/package.json and its lockfile.
The Dev Containers CLI version of the tools lock. The npm manager updates devcontainers-cli/package.json and its lockfile.

packageRules.description: OpenTofu reads its providers from the OpenTofu registry.
The tools of the tools lock come in one pull request for their non-major updates.
A custom manager of a file under k8s/ updates the cluster.
Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. Argo CD tracks main on purpose (ADR 0013), so those dependencies stay off.

Each Grafana plugin release names the Grafana it needs as grafanaDependency, which Renovate cannot read. A minor release can need a newer Grafana minor, so each plugin gets its own pull request, held to the major that the running Grafana major needs.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, check that the Grafana image of the `grafana` chart meets the `grafanaDependency` of this release: https://grafana.com/api/plugins/{{{depName}}}/versions/{{{newVersion}}}. Grafana installs the pinned version at start.

packageRules.description: SearXNG publishes many tags a day, and the tests hold the engine names of the pinned image. A tag has no minimum release age (CONTRIBUTING.md, Dependency Versions), so a person refreshes the engine names at each bump. Each tag ends in a commit hash, which the versioning ignores.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, follow the bump steps in `k8s/README.md`, section SearXNG: refresh `tests/fixtures/searxng/default_engine_names.txt` from the new image and read its notes on the engines that the settings keep.

packageRules.description: A base image update of the service image is a fix, so release-please releases it. Other updates stay chore and release nothing alone.
Coupled pins: a test compares these files, so one pull request updates them all. The trivy-action version inputs, the tools lock and the devcontainer image.
The tools lock, the devcontainer image and the Argo Workflows values tag.
The tools lock, the devcontainer image and the cloudflared image of the cluster.
The two Dockerfiles, the setup-uv version inputs and the runner tools table.
The gh download of the Dockerfile and the runner tools table.
.node-version, the node images, the devcontainer node feature and the runner tools table.
Every Python 3.<minor> place. A new minor gets its own branch, so its Dashboard approval does not stop the digest and patch updates.
prBodyNotes: A new Python minor is a migration: change the other `python3.<minor>` paths (`git grep -n 'python3\.'`) and the `python:3.<minor>-slim` defaults under `src/` in this pull request, then run the full gate.

packageRules.description: The ruff dev dependency and the ruff-pre-commit hook.
The bandit dev dependency, the tools lock and bandit.in and bandit.txt.
The actionlint image of the devcontainer image and of the ci.yml step.
The DCGM exporter chart and image: the exporter version of the image tag is the version of the chart.
The OpenSpec package, its lockfile and the tools lock. The skills that OpenSpec generates hold its version, so the branch writes them again.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, record OpenSpec again for the tests that replay it (`tests/support/openspec_recording.py` says how), and run `uv run devops openspec check`.

packageRules.description: A feature update writes the devcontainer lockfile again with the pinned Dev Containers CLI.
The gh-dash schema fixture holds the schema of the pinned version.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, replace `tests/fixtures/gh_dash_schema/` with the schema of the new version. `tests/core/test_gh_dash_config.py` checks it against the version of the tools lock.

packageRules.description: The tuicr configuration test runs the pinned binary.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `uv run devops ci test tests/config/test_tuicr_config.py` with the new binary.

packageRules.description: A LiteLLM release can change the gateway configuration and its migrations.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, follow the upgrade plan of #4406: read the release notes and the migrations, and load `k8s/llm/gateway/config.yaml` with the new release.

packageRules.description: pydantic-ai 2.67 and later cap google-genai below 3, and the lock holds an older pydantic-ai, so lock maintenance would move google-genai to 3 alone. The pydantic-ai move of #5098 removes this hold.
